mentions.name: Datavessel
mentions.description: A SaaS that connects data sources such as Google Analytics, Search Console, and Shopify stores and lets users query their data in plain English through an agentic AI loop. It is bring-your-own-key and free for reasonable use, aimed at people frustrated by GA4's complexity.
mentions.problem: GA4 and similar analytics tools are complex, making it hard to query your own store and analytics data.
mentions.audience: If you're not crazy about GA4 complexity and the like, this little SaaS will help you connect your data sources and talk to your data in plain english.
mentions.source_excerpt: working on https://datavessel.io - Talk to your google analytics / search console / shopify store in plain english.
